titles.native: KUBBE GACHAPIN MUKKU～キュッパ ガチャピン ムック～

description: A crossover between Kubbe and Fuji TV's Gachapin Mukku program. This short was made to promote the Kubbe: Kort Animasjon anime having a TV run on Gachapin's program Hirake! Ponkikki along with crossover merchandise featuring characters from both franchises.
